She walked along the quiet road that bordered the old orchard, where the last of the evening light caught the apples still hanging from the branches. The air smelled of grass and rain, and somewhere in the distance a dog barked twice and then went silent. She had come back to this place after many years, expecting everything to have changed, and yet the gate still hung crooked on its hinges exactly as she remembered it from childhood summers spent here with her grandparents.
